name: Hollow-Legged Tripod (Li Ding)
dimensions: Diameter: 27.7 cm (10 7/8 in.); Overall: 23 cm (9 1/16 in.)
summary: This food vessel exhibits a new decorative trend of metropolitan Western Zhou foundries. Zoomorphic images became increasingly abstract and subject to linear elaboration. The dominating animal mask (taotie) of the Shang is here transformed, dissolved, and dissected into intricate patterns of curving
